about: Renders a quotation inside a line of text. The browser adds the quotation marks of the language in `lang`.

marks.about: `auto` adds the browser's quotation marks. `none` adds no marks, for text that contains its own punctuation.
marks.title: Marks

motion.about: The animation a quotation enters with. Each one runs once when the quotation mounts.
motion.title: Motion

title: Quote

tone.about: The quotation in every text ink, inside a line of body text. The inverted ink is for a dark surface, so its cell renders on `bg.inverted`.
tone.title: Inks
